name: Stella - Warm and Natual
description: A warm, down-to-earth, and conversational voice perfect for storytelling, lifestyle narration, and casual podcast content. Her tone is ideal for relatable monologues, everyday conversations, and narration that feels personal and genuine.

name: Omọba Adéwálé
description: A deep, authoritative Nigerian male voice in his late 30s. Professional Lagos corporate accent with authentic Nigerian cadence and natural local pronunciation. Grounded, warm, and intensely persuasive—sounding like an experienced energy consultant and tough-love financial mentor. Measured pacing with commanding pauses, delivering realistic weight on Nigerian infrastructure, fuel, and daily business realities. Crisp, articulate, and completely natural. No cartoonish hype or transatlantic drift.

description: Lively, charismatic, and full of personality! Ade is the voice that keeps conversations flowing, making every word feel engaging and natural. With a fast-paced yet clear delivery, this voice is perfect for upbeat ads, entertaining podcasts, storytelling, and energetic brand messaging. Whether it’s casual banter or persuasive selling, Ade makes sure your message is heard loud and clear!

Prince O - A warm, calming African voice with a rich Lagos Nigerian accent
simple yet energetic, high-toned delivery.

Smooth yet vibrant, perfect for brands seeking a unique, trustworthy voice.

name: Tobi - Clear, Steady and Calm African English     Voice  (Explainers and Corporates)
description: A calm, clear African English narration voice suitable for explainers, corporate presentations, audiobooks, and educational content. Tobi’s  delivery is steady and neutral, designed for long-form listening without fatigue.

name: Ayodeji - Warm fatherly register
description: Ayodeji Samuels' voice. Warm fatherly register, Calgary-based Nigerian-British accent. Trained across six tonal contexts (conversational, warm bedtime, instructive, celebratory, reflective prayer, declarative storytelling).

name: Ola - Nigerian Storyteller
description: A deep, resonant Nigerian voice with natural gravitas and warmth. Perfect for documentary narration, audiobooks, commercials, and e-learning.  Delivers authority without intimidation - optimistic, sincere, and deeply engaging. Ideal for brands seeking a distinctive, trustworthy voice that stands out from generic American/British options.

name: John - Balanced & Serious Narration
description: A warm, serious, balanced voice that allows the genre to speak for itself with deliberate, meaningful pauses for key moments. It provides the clarity and articulation needed to follow an intricate plot, calm and measured to make the narration feel believable, and the seriousness to honor the themes of the story. Great for storytelling or narrating crime, documentary, lore, epic tales, history, and audiobooks.

name: Jake – Deep, Smooth, Dramatic
description: A deep male voice with a smooth tone and dramatic presence, built for immersive narration and character-driven storytelling. Ideal for audiobooks, fiction, fantasy, sci-fi, thrillers, documentaries, cinematic projects, YouTube narration, podcasts, and high-character voice generation. Clear delivery and steady pacing allow emotional range and distinct character shifts while remaining easy to follow in long-form listening sessions.

name: Charles - Social Media, TV & Commercial
description: A bold, charismatic male voice that brings energy, clarity, and authenticity to every project. Perfect for creators, brands, and storytellers who want to connect with modern audiences through powerful, relatable narration. Charles delivers a natural conversational tone that fits seamlessly across every corner of social media — from quick-hit Shorts and TikToks to long-form storytelling and branded campaigns.

This profile is specially tuned for dialogue-heavy narration. With over 1.5 billion characters across his other profiles, Viraj is already one of ElevenLabs’ most celebrated voices.

Great fit for Audible, PocketFM, Spotify, KukuFM, & other longform platforms.
